results.name: All nine skill ranks scale useful power and reduce recovery
Iron Requiem ranks extend the ward and increase real damage absorption
Marked for Silence ranks increase amplification, duration and its final burst
Orbit ranks change actual radius, pulse strength and lifetime
Knight parry opens a timed riposte and ordinary or rear guards do not
Rogue backstabs use the target facing and cause a readable reaction
Mage hold and release produces a stronger projectile and early dodge can cancel
Impact pauses movement briefly and retains a dodge pressed during the impact
Enemies coordinate at most two melee commitments and flankers seek side positions
Oathglass reacts to a perfect guard and Bloodbloom reacts to a bleeding death
Grave Echo ricochets only to unhit targets and retains its state through Continue
Embertrail, Duskfeast and Last Ember each have distinct working triggers
Relic art and appearance follow independent equipped slots and survive restoration
Each awakened boss changes arena hazards, leaves safe ground and persists its phase
Lever shortcuts open reciprocal routes, remain optional and persist after Continue
A 3.1 run retains its exact room graph and advances into the new floor revision
Eight directions distinguish every diagonal during movement
Elite branches award a relic once and treasure branches guarantee relic quality
Elite risk stays optional even while shortcut gates are closed
Boss death cancels its arena pulses and projectiles
